html:
G'oya

Har bir smenaning haqi alohida hisoblanadi: 8 soatgacha bo'lsa hours * hourly_rate, ortiq bo'lsa 8 soat oddiy va qolgani ikki baravar. Bu CASE, uni SUM ichiga qo'yib, xodim bo'yicha yig'amiz. Smenasiz xodimlar uchun LEFT JOIN va COALESCE kerak.

Yechim

SELECT e.id, e.name,
       COALESCE(SUM(CASE
                      WHEN s.hours > 8 THEN 8 * e.hourly_rate + (s.hours - 8) * 2 * e.hourly_rate
                      ELSE s.hours * e.hourly_rate
                    END), 0) AS pay
FROM employees e
LEFT JOIN shifts s ON s.employee_id = e.id
GROUP BY e.id, e.name

Aziz uch smena ishlagan: 8, 10 va 4 soat. 160 000 + 240 000 + 80 000 = 480 000. Jasurning smenasi yo'q: LEFT JOIN dan keyin uning qatorida s.hours NULL, CASE ham NULL, SUM ham NULL, COALESCE uni 0 qiladi.

Tuzoqlar

Avval soatlarni qo'shib, keyin qo'shimchasini hisoblash xato. Malika 12 va 6 soat ishlagan, haqiqiy qo'shimcha soat 4 ta. Jami 18 soatdan hisoblasangiz, 10 soat chiqadi:

Noto'g'riSELECT e.id, e.name,
       COALESCE(CASE
                  WHEN SUM(s.hours) > 8
                    THEN 8 * e.hourly_rate + (SUM(s.hours) - 8) * 2 * e.hourly_rate
                  ELSE SUM(s.hours) * e.hourly_rate
                END, 0) AS pay
FROM employees e
LEFT JOIN shifts s ON s.employee_id = e.id
GROUP BY e.id, e.name, e.hourly_rate

Uzun smenaning hamma soatini ikki baravar to'lash ham xato: faqat 8 dan ortig'i qimmatroq.

Boshqa yo'l

Qo'shimcha soatni "yana bir marta to'lanadigan soat" deb qarash mumkin. Shunda har bir smenaning to'lanadigan soatlari hours + (hours - 8), stavka esa yig'indidan keyin bir marta ko'paytiriladi:

SELECT e.id, e.name,
       e.hourly_rate * COALESCE(SUM(s.hours + CASE WHEN s.hours > 8 THEN s.hours - 8 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pay
FROM employees e
LEFT JOIN shifts s ON s.employee_id = e.id
GROUP BY e.id, e.name, e.hourly_rate
